newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK three-year notes avg accepted yield 6.7285 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK three-year notes avg accepted yield 6.7285 pct.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the average accepted price of the three-year Exchange Fund notes tendered on Monday was 99.68 yielding 6.7285 percent versus 6.28 percent at the last tender on January 13.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue eased to HK$1.19 billion from HK$1.49 billion at the last tender.
The lowest accepted price was 99.66 percent, yielding 6.7362 percent while the average tendered yield was 6.74 percent, it said. The notes carry a coupon of 6.50 percent and mature on April 17, 2000.
